crossRefs.note: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that sniffs the wind in her craving. When she is in heat, who can turn her away?…

translations.web: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?
translations.bsb: Can you count the months they are pregnant? Do you know the time they give birth?
translations.kjv: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
translations.asv: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
